cases.title: Speed dragged up, influence not: not passed; it arrives moving and the hint says drag sideways

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names each arrives-moving pair with layer, property and key time from the check ('Title's Position… at 1.5 s the move is still moving when it arrives. Drag that handle sideways, along the bottom', and the same for Scale at 1.5 s), with no numbers and no offer to fix.
Turn 2 says what is off and where for each pair with real names and times, and leaves the work to the learner ('say "done" again when you're ready') without doing it or offering to.

Every layer, property and time in both turns (Title, Position, Scale, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, and the times 0.5, 1.5, 3 and 4.37 s) appears in the snapshot or check output, and 'default shape' follows from not_shaped.
